secondary.name: Trumpet-Dagger
secondary.feature: A small blade welded to the horn's bell

classFeatures.title: Rally
classFeatures.text: Once per session, describe how you rally the party and give yourself and each of your allies a Rally Die (d6). A PC can spend their Rally Die to roll it, adding the result to their action roll, reaction roll, damage roll, or to clear a number of Stress equal to the result. Clear all unspent Rally Dice at end of session. At level 5, Rally Die increases to d8.

classFeatures.title: Make a Scene
classFeatures.text: Spend 3 Hope to temporarily Distract a target within Close range, giving them a -2 penalty to their Difficulty.

subclassFeatures.title: Gifted Performer (Foundation)
subclassFeatures.text: Play three different songs, once each per long rest:
sub: Relaxing Song: You and all allies within Close range clear a Hit Point.
Epic Song: Make a target within Close range temporarily Vulnerable.
Heartbreaking Song: You and all allies within Close range gain a Hope.

subclassFeatures.title: Maestro (Specialization)
subclassFeatures.text: When you give a Rally Die to an ally, they can gain a Hope or clear a Stress.

subclassFeatures.title: Virtuoso (Mastery)
subclassFeatures.text: You can perform each Gifted Performer song twice per long rest.

domainCards.name: Enrapture
domainCards.text: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, they become temporarily Enraptured. While Enraptured, a target's attention is fixed on you, narrowing their field of view and drowning out any sound but your voice. Once per rest on a success, you can mark a Stress to force the Enraptured target to mark a Stress as well.

domainCards.name: Book of Illiat (Illiat's Songbook)
domainCards.text: Telepathy: Spend a Hope to open a line of mental communication with one target you can see. This connection lasts until your next rest or you cast Telepathy again.
additionalSpells: Slumber: Spellcast Roll vs target within Very Close range. On success, they're Asleep until they take damage or the GM spends a Fear.
Arcane Barrage: Once per rest, spend any number of Hope. Shoot magical projectiles at a target within Close range. Roll d6s equal to Hope spent as magic damage.

ancestryFeatures.title: Amphibious
ancestryFeatures.text: You can breathe and move naturally underwater.

ancestryFeatures.title: Long Tongue
ancestryFeatures.text: Use your long tongue to grab things within Close range. Mark a Stress to use your tongue as a Finesse Close weapon that deals d12 physical damage using your Proficiency.

communityFeature.title: Know the Tide (Seaborne)
communityFeature.text: You can sense the ebb and flow of life. When you roll with Fear, place a token on this card.
